input.quote: Except as provided herein, no licenses of the Company's Marks are granted or implied under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property allocation at all: HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and receives all of the Company's Content, yet nothing states who owns the Site or other deliverables, gives the Company any licence to them, or limits HDI's use of Company Content and data. The only IP-adjacent provision is the narrow trademark licence in Section 6.1 (p0038-p0039), which addresses Marks only, and the confidentiality section is not an ownership or licence grant. Nothing assigns Company IP or data to HDI (so this is not walk-away territory), but the fallback is unmet because we hold no licence to the developed Site and HDI's use of our Content and data is unbounded. We therefore insert a short Section 5.5 at the fallback level: HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, the Company receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables for its business, and any HDI licence in Company data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services. We did not push to the preferred assignment of the Site given HDI bears all development costs under Section 1.2.

proposal.summary: Insert an intellectual property section giving the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables, while HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, and limiting HDI's licence in Company data to providing the Services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no intellectual property rights, so we have added a short IP section: HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables for our business, and HDI's licence in our Content and data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services. This is our fallback position.

ops.text: Intellectual Property. HDI retains ownership of its generic tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Site and any other deliverables developed for the Company under this Agreement for its business. Any license granted to HDI in the Content or other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services under this Agreement.
